title: Backup & Restore
adminOnly: Only administrators can manage backups and upgrades.
passphraseHelp: At least 12 characters. Keep it safe to restore this archive.
restoreHelp: Restore stages configuration and secrets in the candidate. Review the diff before committing.
commitHelp: Review these changes, then use the pending changes bar to commit or discard.
staged: Changes staged. Commit using the pending changes bar.
name: Template name
supportHelp: Download diagnostic information with secrets and password hashes removed.
working: Operation in progress. Keep this page open.
rolloutHelp: Activation selects a trial boot. Confirm after booting the new slot, or roll back to the previous confirmed slot.
activateWarning: Select the staged slot for the next trial boot? This action does not reboot the system.
confirmWarning: Confirm the currently running trial slot as the default?
rollbackWarning: Restore the previous confirmed slot as the default boot target? This action does not reboot the system.
noRuns: No scheduled exports have run yet.
noTemplates: No templates saved yet. Create a new template below.
